Key Responsibilities : Onboarding & Offboarding Own the pre-boarding process for new hires: collecting required documents (ID, certificates, experience letters), confirming equipment preferences, and coordinating contract signature. Oversee welcome communications, including office logistics for on-site hires and setup instructions for remote hires. Ensure first-day and first-week onboarding schedules are coordinated smoothly with hiring managers. Own off-boarding processes: exit interviews, documentation, and clearance. HR Operations & Data Ensure employee records in the HRIS are accurate and consistently maintained Track and report on headcount, new hires, and employee lifecycle metrics. Ensure HR documentation (contracts, policies, personnel files) is complete, accurate,and compliant with local labor law (Egypt and/or KSA). Own employee social insurance registration and medical insurance enrollment, including additions, removals, and updates as employees join, change status, or leave. Ensure payroll input processes are accurate and reflect employee data changes on time. Process Improvement & Automation Continuously review People & Culture processes to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement Lead the automation of repetitive manual tasks (e.g. document collection, data entry, standard communications) using HR tech, workflow automation, or AI-based tools where appropriate Build and maintain HR dashboards and reporting to track key people metrics and surface trends Partner with IT and People Ops to evaluate and implement new HR tools and systems Team Leadership Manage and mentor People Specialist(s) and other team members, setting priorities and ensuring consistent, high-quality execution across the employee lifecycle Own workload planning and capacity across the People & Culture function Employee Relations & Support Act as an escalation point for employee questions on policies, benefits, and processes Lead the resolution of employee concerns, handling sensitive matters with discretion Ensure a positive, transparent employee experience across all touch points Culture & Engagement . Own the planning and execution of employee engagement initiatives and events Drive internal communications that reinforce company culture and values Gather and act on employee feedback (e.g. surveys, pulse checks). Policy & Compliance. Develop, update, and communicate HR policies. Ensure onboarding and employment practices remain compliant with local labor regulations across all office locations. Lead internal audits related to HR documentation and process. Requirements Requirements 8–10 years of experience in an HR Generalist, People Operations role. Proven experience managing or mentoring a team, even in a small-team or informal lead capacity. Solid understanding of core HR processes: onboarding, employee records, offboarding, and labor law compliance. Experience working with an HRIS, and ideally experience selecting, implementing, or improving HR tools/processes. Hands-on experience managing social insurance and medical insurance processes for employees. Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple employee cases and team priorities simultaneously. Excellent written and verbal communication in English & Arabic a plus, especially for Egypt/KSA-based roles. High discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential employee information. Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. Nice to Have: Experience automating HR processes using workflow tools (e.g. Power Automate, Zapier) or AI-powered HR tools. Experience supporting both Egypt and KSA-based employees or familiarity with GCC labor law. Experience with engagement or culture-building initiatives. HR or people-management certification (e.g. CIPD, SHRM, PHRi).

review_candidates.description: Successful Candidate may office in either Bowling Green, KY or Franklin, TN THIS JOB DESCRIPTION DOES NOT ATTEMPT TO LIST ALL OF THE DUTIES THAT ARE OR MAY BE PERFORMED IN THIS POSITION Primary Duties Works with vendors and supervisors and may order hardware including laptops, desktops, MDTs, VDI environments, printers, mobile mounting equipment, modems, antennas, and network equipment for employees in a geographical region or corporate locations. Identifies requirements for computer images and configurations to maximize productivity and reliability. May assist in the design, testing, and implementation of standard images. Provides project management on software/hardware upgrades and enhancements. Logs, troubleshoots, updates and follows through on incidents and requests, including incidents that are escalated, until final resolution is reached. May establish and or maintain wireless communications for field users including WMR, Handheld devices and Modems. Uses Software management tools to update and deliver software applications to field computer. Maintains security and encryption software. Participates on teams with other divisions or Shared Services to evaluate, deploy and support enterprise solutions. Acts as a liaison with end users to keep them advised regarding upcoming technology changes and strategies. Coordinates and assists with maintaining an inventory of company IT assets. May support telecom equipment including, phone systems and patch panel facilities in field offices and corporate offices. Assists in the implementation, testing, and configuration of corporate hardware and software computer systems. Evaluates, analyzes and resolves problems associated with maintaining high availability levels of hardware, laptops, tablets and, computer software to maintain enterprise standards. Coordinates with vendors or contractors to assure proper implementation of hardware, related systems and, infrastructure. Keeps abreast of technology changes and makes recommendations on technical changes, training and, adoption rates to improve operating efficiencies. Provides training to field and corporate offices on desktops, laptops, Tablets, and basic software functionality. Education/Experience Level MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS & SKILLS Bachelor's degree in IT and two years related experience; or A general educational knowledge normally acquired through a high school diploma or a General Equivalency Diploma (GED) and four years related experience. Valid driver's license. Communication Skills Requires the ability to communicate with internal and/or external customers in order to obtain and/or provide explanations and/or information on technical concepts to individuals with experience or knowledge of the technical area. Number Skills Requires the ability to perform analyses involving ratios, percentages and comparisons. Computer Skills Requires knowledge of various software applications to create documents, reports and/or graphics. Physical Demands Ability to lift and carry 60 pounds from the ground to 34 inches. (Ex: lifting and carrying servers and equipment). Ability to lift 20 pounds from the ground to 72 inches. (Ex: lifting monitors and equipment to storage). Ability to lift 25 pounds from the ground to 57 inches. (Ex: lifting batteries and equipment). Ability to ascend/descend 3 rungs on a ladder. Ability to bend, stoop, squat, kneel, and/or crouch. Work Conditions Works in an indoor environment. Travel is required. Requires occasionally performing activities including, but not limited to, bending, stooping, grasping, reaching, twisting, turning and/or lifting objects up to 100 pounds (e.g. moving telephone and workstation equipment). Atmos Energy Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, or veteran status. review_candidates.title: French Customer Service back office ( Email & Email)
review_candidates.description: Company Description MICO WORLD MENA is part of MICO WORLD, a world-leading open social platform founded in 2014. The company offers a range of social products, including MICO, YoHo, TopTop, and Sugo, enabling users to connect through messaging, voice and video chat, live streaming, and games. With over 100 million users in more than 150 countries and regions, and more than 150,000 contracted anchors, MICO WORLD has a strong global presence. The organization is deeply involved in markets such as the Middle East, Southeast Asia, South Asia, Europe, and America, and continues to enhance localization and strengthen its brand worldwide. Team members join a fast-growing, internationally focused company dedicated to delivering high-quality social experiences. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site French Customer Service back office role located in Qesm El Maadi. The team member will handle French-language email support, responding to user inquiries, resolving issues, and providing accurate information about MICO WORLD’s products and services. Daily tasks include reviewing and categorizing incoming messages, troubleshooting account and application problems, and escalating complex cases to the appropriate internal teams. The role also involves documenting interactions, following established procedures and service-level agreements, and contributing to continuous improvement of customer service processes. Collaboration with other customer service and operations teams is expected to ensure a consistent and high-quality customer experience. Qualifications Strong customer-facing capabilities, including Customer Support and Customer Service skills. Ability to foster positive outcomes with a focus on Customer Satisfaction and Customer Experience. Professional communication manner, including excellent Phone Etiquette and written email communication skills. Fluency in French (written and spoken) and good command of English; additional languages are a plus. Previous experience in customer service or back office support, preferably in digital, tech, or social media platforms. Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and capacity to follow structured workflows and guidelines. Comfort working with ticketing systems, CRM tools, and basic office software. Ability to work on-site in Qesm El Maadi, manage time effectively, and maintain professionalism in a fast-paced environment.
